text:
Aisha (Product): Heads-up I'm changing legal home base from San Francisco, CA -> Hoboken, NJ effective 2027-06-01. Need checklist: WFH stipend, payroll state taxes, benefits network, and any equity/tax paperwork.
Jen (People Ops): Congrats on the move! Quick Q: is this permanent or trial?
Aisha (Product): Permanent. Partner relocated so I'm moving households.
Sam (Payroll): Thanks for flagging. For payroll we will change state tax withholding to NJ on the first payroll after 2027-06-01. You'll need to complete a new state withholding form (NJ-W4 equivalent) and confirm home address in Rippling.
Rafael (Benefits): For medical/dental: NJ falls in a different provider network. If you keep the same plan carrier nothing to do, but provider access may differ. We should run an eligibility check and let you know if network gaps exist. Also update your address for FSA/HSA records.
Aisha (Product): Will do. Do I need to re-enroll in benefits or will plan follow me automatically?
Rafael (Benefits): Most plans auto-follow but sometimes carrier requires a postcode update. I'll run the carrier check and DM you. If there's a meaningful network change we can offer a special enrollment window.
Maria (Tax): One note on employer exposure: a single employee moving to NJ usually doesn't create a corporate nexus, but if we open an office or >3 full-time employees establish NJ homebase we need to escalate. For now we log it. Keep receipts for relocation expenses if you claim any.
Sam (Payroll): WFH stipend: since it's a homebase change, stipend stays the same dollar amount but payroll tax treatment follows NJ rules. We'll prorate the current month's stipend depending on effective date. If you want to opt into a one-time moving expense reimbursement instead, we can do that via expenses.
Aisha (Product): Prefer to keep stipend, avoid extra expense forms. Prorate is fine.
Jen (People Ops): Action items: Aisha fill `/forms/homebase-change` (fields: name, old_address, new_address, effective_date, reason, emergency_contact). Also attach proof of new address (lease or utility bill).
peopleops-bot: Reminder: Please complete `/forms/homebase-change` within 72 hours to prevent benefits/payroll delays.
Sam (Payroll): I'll prepare the payroll entry: change state withholding start 2027-06-15 pay run; prorated stipend for June. Also update state tax codes on your W-2 records.
Rafael (Benefits): I'll run provider network check and post back in 24-48h. If you need to change providers we'll offer a special enrollment effective first of next month.
Maria (Tax): Also flagging relocation for equity tax withholding team: changing homebase can affect state tax at vesting/RSU sell. We'll notify compops to update your equity profile.
Aisha (Product): Thanks. Timeline: moving weekend of May 29, will complete form tonight and attach lease.
Jen (People Ops): Great. I'll mark this as "homebase change - pending docs" and attach TR-2027-550 to your people record once form is in.
peopleops-bot: Homebase Change Request logged (ID #TR-2027-550).
Sam (Payroll): Posting: "Payroll tasks queued: NJ withholding start, June stipend prorate". Will confirm once run.
Aisha (Product): Appreciate it. One more Q: commuter pre-tax transit—do I need to update anything when I switch states?
Rafael (Benefits): Commuter plans are state/metro specific. If you enroll in a NJ transit plan we can switch your payroll deductions; let benefits know preferred start date.
Maria (Tax): Final: keep travel/move docs and employment calendar for 2 years in case of state audit. Not uncommon to be asked for proof of domicile change.
Jen (People Ops): Closing this thread when payroll & benefits confirm. Thanks all.
Aisha (Product): Done - submitted form and lease attached. DM'd Sam my driver's license. :thumbsup:
